decisions.why: Examples BlueDiver II/I are laboratory indirect-immunofluorescence processing instruments for autoimmune serology testing, i.e. lab analyser equipment.

Examples ez-Track1, ez-Tracker and i-Tracker are automated lab tracker/analyser instruments in the same autoimmune/biologics diagnostics instrument family as this supplier's other lab equipment (BlueDiver, i-Track 10).
Example i-Track 10 is an automated laboratory ELISA-processing instrument, i.e. lab analyser equipment.
Example LISA TRACKER is an ELISA immunoassay kit for monitoring biologic drug levels, i.e. a laboratory reagent consumable rather than the instrument that runs it.
